verdict.rationale: Jules is explicitly built for this workflow: assign a bug via GitHub issue label, it clones the repo in a VM, plans, makes code changes, and opens a PR for review (jules-docs-2,3,4,7,8). Community evidence corroborates real bug-fixing use (jules-comm-14, jules-comm-16) but also shows failures on complex/monorepo codebases, infinite loops, and inconsistent quality (jules-comm-9,10,13,15), so autonomy is real but not fully reliable. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of bug-fix success rate, and evidence of consistent performance on complex bugs beyond anecdotal reports.
